channel.title: Havok Restoration blog
channel.description: Straight answers on water, fire, mold and storm damage for Bay Area homeowners.

item.title: Atmospheric River Prep Checklist for East Bay Homeowners
item.description: What the AR 1 to 5 scale means for your home, plus a 48-hour checklist: gutters, drains, sandbags, sump pumps, outages and what to photograph first.

item.title: The First 24 Hours After a House Fire: A Checklist
item.description: A calm checklist for the first day after a house fire: safety and the fire department release, securing the home, calling your insurer, and what to save.

item.title: Is It Mold or Mildew? When to Clean It and When to Call a Pro
item.description: How to tell surface mildew from mold, the EPA's 10-square-foot rule for DIY cleanup, safe cleaning steps, and the signs that mold is growing inside your walls.

item.title: Should You File a Water Damage Claim in California? A Decision Guide
item.description: Not every leak is worth a claim. Weigh your deductible, claims history and CLUE report, and learn what California law requires of your insurer.

item.title: What to Do in the First Hour After Water Damage
item.description: Water on the floor? Stop the source, make the room safe, document everything and start drying within 24 to 48 hours. The first hour, step by step.
